name: Drum vs Belt vs Orbital Sander: What Your Everett Contractor Uses
title-tag: Drum vs Belt vs Orbital Floor Sanders: Everett, WA Guide
meta-description: Drum, belt, and orbital sanders cut differently and fail differently. An Everett contractor on what each machine does, and why rental drums gouge floors.
post-summary: November 18, 2026 · Drum, belt, and orbital sanders are three different cutting actions with three different failure modes — and the drum sander rental shops hand out is the one that gouges floors. What we run instead, why the grit ladder matters, and why Everett’s soft old fir forgives equipment mistakes least of all.
